title: As-Salam and the Kind Word
summary: «And speak to people kindly.» Teach your child *as-salam* (the greeting of peace) upon entering and gratitude upon receiving; the kind word is *sadaqah* (charity), and planting it early shapes a beautiful heart and tongue.
try_this: This week: Train your child to give *as-salam* when entering the house, and be the *qudwah* (example) yourself every time.

review_defects.arabic: علّمي طفلك السلام عند الدخول والشكر عند العطاء
review_defects.english: Teach your child as-salam (the greeting of peace) upon entering and gratitude upon receiving
review_defects.why: The Arabic 'العطاء' means 'giving', not 'receiving'. The instruction is to teach thanks when giving, but the translation says 'upon receiving', which reverses the intended meaning.
